item.name: POST place order, app sends a fake total (customer)

exec: pm.test("Server worked out the total itself (not the 1 the app sent)", function () { pm.expect(o.total).to.not.eql(1); pm.expect(o.total).to.eql(Math.round((o.subtotal + o.serviceCharge + o.tax - o.discount) * 100) / 100); });
pm.test("Price comes from the database, order starts Pending", function () { pm.expect(o.items[0].price).to.not.eql(1); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql("Pending"); });
